definitions: An important assignment, often involving travel abroad.
A strongly felt aim, ambition, or calling.
A group of people sent to a foreign country to carry out a specific task.
A permanent diplomatic office of one country in another.
An operation, especially a military one, assigned to a person or group.
examples: He was sent on a diplomatic mission.
Her mission in life was to help others.
The trade mission visited several countries.
The UN mission is located in the capital.
The fighter pilots completed their mission.
